headline: Learning summary for 2026-09-02: moneyline record 1-0 (100.0%).

gates.note: Official picks require high model probability and strong setup quality. A high Lab Rating alone is not enough. (Market edge is no longer a gate -- a picked side with a lower market-implied probability than the model's read can still qualify, as long as market data exists for the game at all.)

findings.title: Official-pick discipline
findings.read: 1 moneyline pick was graded today. Record: 1-0 (100.0%).

findings.title: Probability gate
findings.read: No high-Lab, low-probability moneyline setups appeared in the graded official set.

findings.title: What's working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: Over 283 graded picks with a reconciling breakdown, pitching plan is the strongest working piece of Lab Rating right now -- picks scoring above its median win 62.7% of the time vs. 54.4% below (lift +8.3%, correlation to winning +0.104).

findings.title: What's not working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: bullpen -- correlation to winning -0.088, lift -8.8% over 283 picks. Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record.

findings.title: Bullpen learning
findings.read: Across all reviewed days, 9 graded moneyline picks carried a meaningful bullpen caution. Statistically, Lab Rating's bullpen component correlates -0.088 with winning over 283 picks (lift -8.8%). Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record.

findings.title: Pitcher learning
findings.read: No major starting-pitcher conflicts showed up in the graded moneyline set. Statistically, the pitching-plan component correlates +0.104 with winning over 283 picks (lift +8.3%).

findings.title: Rating calibration
findings.read: Actual win rate by Lab Rating band: 0-49 → 55.3% (n=114), 50-64 → 56.7% (n=90), 65-74 → 63.0% (n=46), 75-84 → 67.9% (n=28), 85-100 → 60.0% (n=5). Widest predicted-vs-actual gap is the 85-100 band (-12.7%). The top band has only 5 graded picks so far -- too few to trust its win rate yet, watch as the sample grows.

shadow_model.note: Only rows from the latest matching official/shadow model-version pair are compared. Promote nothing from a mixed-version sample.

attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

calibration.note: Shadow ledger for learning only — never part of the public record. Official picks stay the only published record.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 250-178 (58.4%), n=428. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.
LyDia's own win probability for this pick: r=0.079 (n=428) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.54): 56-51 (52.3%). Top quarter (0.71 to 0.74): 63-44 (58.9%).
Lab Rating's conviction component score: r=0.077 (n=428) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 1.96): 58-49 (54.2%). Top quarter (18.10 to 35.00): 67-40 (62.6%).
Lab Rating's bullpen component score: r=-0.064 (n=428) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (1.10 to 5.67): 72-35 (67.3%). Top quarter (12.19 to 20.00): 58-49 (54.2%).
Probability points bullpen risk moved this pick's number: r=-0.064 (n=428) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.14 to -0.03): 68-39 (63.6%). Top quarter (0.05 to 0.17): 59-48 (55.1%).

Bullpen risk edge (positive = the picked side's bullpen is the safer one): r=-0.064 (n=428) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-48.00 to -10.00): 68-39 (63.6%). Top quarter (17.00 to 55.00): 59-48 (55.1%).

Size of the price (how big a favorite or underdog this pick was): r=-0.057 (n=422) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (100.00 to 115.00): 58-47 (55.2%). Top quarter (159.00 to 850.00): 66-41 (61.7%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): official_pick 25-11 (69.4%, n=36) vs. watchlist 37-25 (59.7%, n=62) vs. pass 185-138 (57.3%, n=323) vs. value_watch 3-4 (42.9%, n=7).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 142-89 (61.5%, n=231) vs. Road 108-89 (54.8%, n=197).
These are correlations across LyDia's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
